reason: Primary purpose is a local SKILL management utility for DSH: discover local skill definitions from filesystem paths, keep them synchronized with live watches, and present them in a web settings page for user selection/usage guidance. It is a plugin utility with web UI affordances, not a code-generation or external automation tool.

capabilities: Scans local filesystem directories for skill definition files
Watches local skill directories for add/modify/delete and refreshes in real time
Parses markdown skill files with YAML frontmatter
Registers discovered skills into the host skill provider
Displays skills in a web settings page with copyable usage guidance

reasons.code: Readme states local skill discovery from user-provided directories (default ~/.dsh/local-skills) with two accepted file formats and metadata in YAML frontmatter.
Readme explicitly describes chokidar-based live watch of filesystem events with invalidation/refresh behavior for model directory and UI.
Readme and package manifest show a split host/client plugin design (lib/index.js plus lib/client.js) with a web Settings page for listing and invoking skills.
Manifest exposes a web client platform and bundles via cordis patch, confirming intent to run as a DSH plugin component rather than a standalone remote service.
Repository includes sample local skill files under skills/ and no evidence of remote data ingestion or outbound service integration in the provided metadata.
